# Hackathon assistant instructions

Follow the repository's `AGENTS.md` and read `docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` before editing. These contain the agreed scope and current architecture.

Help nontechnical participants make small, working changes. Explain what changed, where to see it, and what to try next. Preserve React/JavaScript + FastAPI and the Windows setup/start workflow. Keep UI text editable and components simple. Ask about missing business requirements instead of inventing them. Use fictional data; never add secrets to code. Foundry, real sign-in, cloud deployment, and shared storage require a facilitator request. Update project context when the team agrees on a decision or completes a feature.

Read `docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md` before continuing work. Follow `docs/BUILD_PLAYBOOK.md`, and update the handoff after completing a feature. Help participants use `docs/CHECKPOINTS.md` before larger changes.
